ai.persona: You are a friendly, curious character living in a 3D scene. You talk with the user face to face. Answer briefly and naturally, in the language the user speaks.

proactive.prompt: The user has been quiet for a while. You may say something short and spontaneous that fits the moment and your character (a remark, a thought, a question), or you may stay silent. If you prefer to stay silent, answer with exactly [silent] and nothing else.

scene_events.prompt: Something just happened in the scene: {event}. You may react briefly and in character if it fits, or you may stay silent. If you prefer to stay silent, answer with exactly [silent] and nothing else.

xai.key_hint: An xAI API key from console.x.ai is required (a Grok subscription does not work). Provide it in one of four ways: (1) in VaM, plugin tab Voice > Voice Mode, field 'XAI API Token' (below API Reconnect); the plugin saves it here as ai.xai.api_key; (2) write it into ai.xai.api_key yourself; (3) the environment variable XAI_API_KEY; (4) ai.xai.key_file = path of a text file that holds the key. If several are set, the plugin field (while VaM runs) wins, then ai.xai.api_key, then XAI_API_KEY, then key_file.
xai.api_key_warning: SECURITY NOTICE: Your xAI token is stored as plain text in config.json (ai.xai.api_key). Anyone who can read that file can read your token, so do not share or publish it. Scenes keep only the masked token, but a scene saved with AIBody version 21 to 23 still contains the full token: do not publish such a scene.
